ruleLine: pierna = one rank in three DIFFERENT suits / escalera = a suit run (one joker at most, never in a pierna)
selectHint: Click cards to select, then Meld / Lay off / Discard
roundWinnerClean: Seat {{n}} went out in one go (-10)
landscapeBanner: Turn your device sideways for a better view
tutorial.deck: The pack is 108 cards (two 52-card decks plus four jokers), so every card turns up twice.
tutorial.pierna: A pierna is three or more of a rank, but it needs three DIFFERENT suits. A second card of the same suit does not make the set.
tutorial.joker: Jokers are not wild. They go only in an escalera, one per run, and cannot be discarded — holding one costs ten.
tutorial.score: Cards left in hand are penalty points. A player is knocked out at 101, and the last one standing wins.
layOffTargetHint: Click the meld to add to as well — only a hand card is selected
